items.title: Ask HN: Do you talk to bots online? How has it changed? (Source: hnrss.org | Category: Hacker News)
items.content_text: I comment from time to time. Sometimes I notice I'm going back/forth with a bot. Anecdotally, 2+ years ago bots were clearly stupid. I'm recently encountering a lot less obvious bots, and a lot more lawyer-sounding commenters. This has me concerned, because I'm sure the bots are still out there, but their tactics have improved. Do you avoid bots? How do you identify them? Have you noticed any changes in them? Apologies if this is not a valid HN question topic. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50111773 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
